processes.amkernel: PID of the installed-wheel amkernel stdio server started by the official MCP Python client
processes.appiumServer: PID of the Appium 3.7.0 server accepting the configured base URL
processes.platformDriver: the UiAutomator2 server PID read from the Android device with adb shell pidof io.appium.uiautomator2.server or the WebDriverAgentRunner PID on the macOS iOS host; PID reuse invalidates the run

darwinHost.openFiles: count of lsof -Fn -p PID file records
darwinHost.tasks: count of ps -M PID thread rows excluding the header
darwinHost.descendants: recursive process-tree count from ps -axo pid=,ppid=

androidDevice.rssBytes: adb -s DEVICE shell cat /proc/PID/status VmRSS, multiplied by 1024
androidDevice.openFiles: count of entries from adb -s DEVICE shell ls /proc/PID/fd
androidDevice.tasks: Threads value from adb -s DEVICE shell cat /proc/PID/status
androidDevice.descendants: recursive child count from adb -s DEVICE shell ps -A -o PID,PPID

instruments.artifactIntegrity: host reads retained bytes, records decoded size, computes SHA-256, and compares both with AMKernel metadata
instruments.encodedScreenshotIntegrity: when a screenshot crosses JSON as base64, record encoded UTF-8 bytes and require strict base64 decode to equal the retained decoded bytes

schedule.freshProcessDefinition: terminate the MCP client and AMKernel process, verify their exit, then start a new installed-wheel entry point; create a new Appium session for each session-startup trial
schedule.warmupDefinition: one complete task, screenshot, and page-source sequence; retain correctness artifacts and the required post-warm-up process sample but exclude warm-up latency from steady-state summaries
schedule.steadyStateDefinition: ten complete task, screenshot, and page-source sequences in one live kernel and Appium session; sample every process after iterations 1, 5, and 10

baselineSubtraction.latencyBaseline: immediately before steady-state measurement, run ten execute calls whose body is pass; use median runner duration as the per-cell baseline
baselineSubtraction.derivedLatency: retain raw and baseline values; derived milliseconds equal max(0, raw minus baseline)
baselineSubtraction.activeDriverMemory: for AMKernel and Appium Server, subtract the same-PID pre-session-idle RSS from post-session-baseline RSS; the platform driver does not exist pre-session, so use its first stable same-PID post-session-baseline sample and report change from that baseline at iteration 10; retain every raw sample
baselineSubtraction.contextReduction: measure identical UTF-8 serialized content immediately before and after deterministic local reduction; derived bytes equal before minus after

plateau.comparison: sample after iteration 10 minus sample after iteration 5
plateau.passRule: every metric for every process is at or below its maximum; process replacement or missing same-PID samples fails

modelFacingPageSource.completeSourcePolicy: retain only as a bounded AMKernel artifact and workflow artifact; never place complete source in model-facing output

passFail.latency: all required trials and iterations exist, each summary is derived from retained raw observations, and every ceiling passes
passFail.resource: AMKernel and Appium Server have pre-session idle samples; all three process classes have post-session baseline, post-warm-up, and iteration 1, 5, and 10 samples; same-PID active-memory and plateau gates pass
passFail.integrity: all retained screenshot, source, and log sizes and SHA-256 digests independently match
passFail.unavailable: fail the run unless the owning platform Issue named the unavailable instrument before execution, justified it, and named an equivalent substitute; record unavailable and substitute observations without null, zero, or inferred values
passFail.reclassification: thresholds may not be relaxed and failed evidence may not be reclassified after observation without an Issue contract update and independent review followed by a fresh run
